$comment: Limits in bytes for scripts/check-bundle-budgets.cjs. Started at the 2026-11-02 build plus 3%; renderer.entry gzip and main.index raised on 2026-11-14 to that day's main build plus 1%; main.total gzip raised the same day to 1,835.4 kB plus 1% (the spawn census and the /proc process reader, pull request 192); renderer.startup gzip raised the same day to 783.2 kB plus 1% (the git refresh clock, pull request 193); main.index raw and gzip and main.total raw and gzip raised the same day to the budgets job's measure plus 1% (main.index 2,073.6 / 680.9 kB, main.total 5,634.9 / 1,838.4 kB) for the graphics-card switch and its safety net (pull request 196). renderer.entry raw and renderer.startup raw raised on 2026-11-15 to that day's build plus 1% (1,787.0 and 2,737.3 kB) for the rail's paced read round (pull request 199). renderer.entry gzip raised on 2026-11-17 to that day's build plus 1% (543.6 kB, from main's 540.9 kB) for the browser tools' agent-facing results and errors (pull request 230). The Source Control tab strip (pull request 226, which keeps the GitHub block mounted behind its tabs) adds about 0.4 kB gzip to the entry chunk and fits under that limit. renderer.startup gzip raised on 2026-11-17 from 791.0 to 793.0 kB for the Source Control commit box at the top of the Changes tab (pull request 227, measured 791.6 kB). Raised the same day for the Source Control compact lists and their folder-safe discard (pull request 228): renderer.entry raw 1,805.0 to 1,812.0 kB (measured 1,807.0), renderer.startup gzip 793.0 to 795.0 kB (793.2), main.index gzip 688.0 to 690.0 kB (688.2, the folder discard check), preload.total gzip 12.0 to 12.2 kB (12.0, its bridge). Raised the same day for the agent on the user's Chrome page (pull request 234: the stop list Codara keeps, saves and sends to the extension, its failsafe and the give back call) to the budgets job's measure plus 1%: main.index raw 2,095.0 to 2,122.0 kB (measured 2,100.3), main.index gzip 690.0 to 698.0 kB (690.5), main.total gzip 1,857.0 to 1,878.0 kB (1,859.0); its renderer pieces load with Settings and fit under renderer.startup. main.total raw raised on 2026-11-17 from 5,692.0 to 5,751.1 kB (measured 5,694.1 kB plus 1%) for the worker feed: a Cora worker's steps kept per attempt, read by the chat and the message-a-worker call. Raised the same day for the worker rows that open a worker's own chat in Cora (pull request 248: the row button, the open-worker context and the panel's inside-a-worker state; the worker view itself loads lazily): renderer.entry raw 1,812.0 to 1,830.7 kB (measured 1,812.6) and renderer.startup raw 2,765.0 to 2,793.8 kB (measured 2,766.1), each measured plus 1%. renderer.startup gzip raised on 2026-11-18 from 795.0 to 803.1 kB (measured 795.1 kB plus 1%, after main's 2026-11-18 build) for the same worker rows and, above them, the agents rail's mount point and its preload read (pull requests 248 and 257). renderer.entry gzip raised on 2026-11-18 from 549.0 to 555.4 kB (measured 549.9 kB plus 1%) for the agent tool marks in the new-tab picker: each worker row shows its tool's update state and its Update button, which the picker needs as soon as it opens; the Settings section loads with Settings. main.total gzip raised on 2026-11-18 from 1,880.0 to 1,898.3 kB (measured 1,879.5 kB plus 1%, on main with pull request 274) for an agent removing a worktree it made and gave up: the closed pull request lookup and its proof in the removal check, and the asking agent's own tab no longer counted as a use in the cleanup tool. main.total raw raised on 2026-11-19 from 5,751.1 to 5,809.2 kB (measured 5,751.7 kB plus 1%) for the Cora route order (pull request 223): the route choice, its per-run Routes rows, and keeping compaction, turn recovery and worker planning on the chosen route. main.index raised on 2026-11-19 to the budgets job's measure plus 1% (raw 2,122.0 to 2,159.4 kB, measured 2,138.0; gzip 698.0 to 710.7 kB, measured 703.7) for the Firefox link's input and refusals on Firefox tabs (pull request 288, on main with pull request 287: per-tab access stamps and the page-event input played by the extension). preload.total gzip raised on 2026-11-19 from 12.2 to 12.36 kB (measured 12.24 kB plus 1%) for the Firefox add-on's easy install (pull request 294: the bridge calls that copy manifest.json's path and open about:debugging in the user's Firefox). Raise one only in the pull request that needs it and say why; lower one after a size win. renderer.entry raw raised on 2026-11-21 to that day's build (1,831.4 kB) plus 1%: the browser pane's page-backdrop probe (pageBackdrop.ts, pull request 300) put it 0.7 kB over a limit that main already used to 100%. Raised on 2026-11-22 to that day's build plus 1% for the Pi and Antigravity session pickers (pull request 302: agy's conversation list and live conversations read from its summary table, and the --continue guard over every workspace's saved tabs): renderer.entry gzip 555.4 to 561.1 kB (measured 555.5), main.index raw 2,159.4 to 2,183.2 kB (measured 2,161.5) and gzip 710.7 to 718.5 kB (measured 711.4), main.total gzip 1,898.3 to 1,917.4 kB (measured 1,898.3), preload.total gzip 12.36 to 12.51 kB (measured 12.38).
